results.text:
For those of us on the recruiting front, the effects of this have been pretty evident for a few months.

Crypto teams are optimizing for candidates w/ enterprise, B2B, demand gen, growth and product marketing experience.

i.e. people who are technical, data driven marketers that build brands by working across content, comms, strategy etc (and who leverage AI tooling) are in high demand.

Edge cases aside, social, community, dev rel and other hype driven marketing roles are almost non-existent.

results.bio: Web3 Writer ➠ SMM ➠ CM➠ Graphics designer ➠  Website Designer ➠Guardian @solflare
results.text:
Check who you're hiring.

North Korean developers have worked inside 40+ DeFi projects using fake identities Some of them were behind the hacks that came later.

This happens because projects don't check. Good GitHub, quick test, full access. No verification. That's how they get in.

Vet every developer. Check identities. Audit real work. Monitor access. No shortcuts.

And for users  always disconnect your wallet after using any dApp A connected wallet is an open door.

Stay safe.
